beats.text:
The door opens before you knock.

She has been standing on the other side of it for a while.

text.Guns: She was already at the door. She needed you to be someone.
text.Bible: Waiting like that isn't patience. That's a vigil.
text.Crystals: She's been standing there so long her feet must ache. Nobody stands like that for nothing.

text.Guns:
Behind you, the diploma hangs level.

She sees it before she sees you.
text.Bible:
She looks down. The mat says WELCOME now.

She reads it twice.
text.Crystals:
Over your head the hall light holds steady.

She looks up at it like it said her name.

text.Guns: Don't mind the frame. It's been crooked since... it's been crooked.
text.Bible: Wipe your feet. The mat says go away. It doesn't mean you.
text.Crystals: Mind the light. It's been dying for months. I keep meaning to.

text.Guns: You walked right past the crooked frame. She noticed.
text.Bible: You stepped over the mat. She saw which side was up.
text.Crystals: You walked under the dying bulb and left it dying. She noticed.

options.label: Say nothing. Let her fill it.

lie.ledgerEntry: You claimed you'd fixed something for Deborah that you hadn't.
You told Deborah you were from the church.
